interrupted_motion.semantics: Stop cancels travel intent; balancing targets continue. The walk is cancelled/unverified; separate post-ACK rest is confirmed. No instantaneous motor-off or no-inertia claim.

composed_reverse_veto.note: Both solved non-sole contact rows carry zero normal/vector force; this is not evidence of load-bearing ankle support. The existing any-forbidden-contact veto still applies. No force filter or registry relaxation was introduced.

visual_scope: MP4s encode only saved native RGB frames at actual simulation timestamps. Start/middle/end frames were visually inspected. Images do not replace independent physical metrics.
